g.text: Percentages = pixels of this frame at the ADC maximum (255). Frame colours of (h)–(j) follow the method encoding (blue LRFC-style HDR, red ML-HDR Eq. 14–15 as published, green saturation-mask extension). The frames are single runs (seed 0).

text.tspan: longest exposure; negative rates clipped to 0. Colour = log(1 + counts), so zero counts sit at the bottom of the one shared scale.
